decisions.reason: As a modular accessory close to our installed machine base, it is relatively low-cost to carry and still fits our aspiration levels well enough to remain on the market while we learn from demand.

Because it is distant from our established offer and likely underperforms compared with the aspirations set by our core businesses, we would redirect attention and development resources to nearer, more reliable opportunities.
This machine line is central to our core strategy, leverages our strongest technical and service capabilities, and in a growing market its results are unlikely to fall below withdrawal thresholds.

The automatic tool change system strengthens the value of our core equipment, uses existing engineering and service resources, and can be retained within available organizational slack while adoption matures.
